    from collections import Counter

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

                y, x = stack.pop()
                component.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            components.append(component)

    template = max(components, key=len)
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in template), max(r for r, c in template)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in template), max(c for r, c in template)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    pattern = [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c]) for r, c in template]

    template_cells = set(template)

        for dr, dc, value in pattern:
